title: Broncos RJ Harvey practices on Thursday; Marvin Mims did not

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos RJ Harvey practices on Thursday; Marvin Mims did not
sources.description: The Denver Broncos offered a bit of good news reporting that running back RJ Harvey was back practicing in a limited way today. The hamstring issue appears to be of the very minor sort. The bigger concern now is that wide receiver Marvin Mims Jr. has been held out of practice with a foot injury. […]
